ShortDescription.Value: Removes the lane changes at a station's track ends, so long trains stop straight on their platform.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Straight Train Stop
*stupid trains where they think they're going*
## How to use
- Select a railway station and open **Visual Customisation**. - **Straight-only platforms** lists the station's platform tracks, with a switch for each end (left and right as seen from the station's street side). - Switch an end on to remove its lane changes: trains reach that platform only straight on. The junction itself stays. - The switch at the top sets every end at once. - Only the station's own tracks change: tracks you placed yourself, metro and tram are never touched. - A lane change with a train on it goes once the train has passed. Choices are saved with the city.
## Before you install
Removed lane changes are not part of the save. If you uninstall the mod, a station you changed stays without them until its tracks are regenerated, for example by upgrading or rebuilding the station. Switch every station off before uninstalling to avoid this.
Free and open source under the MIT licence: [source on GitHub](https://github.com/merrinaf-tech/Straight-Train-Stop).
